overview:
Arches is an Asia-focused expert network founded in 2019, headquartered in Tokyo. Its services connect investors, consulting firms, and corporations with specialists for calls and research. Arches reports 200,000+ experts worldwide and says it serves 600+ businesses across 300+ industries. These scale figures are company-stated.

The Expert Transcript Library provides searchable interviews and AI summaries. In a December 17, 2025 announcement, Arches described access to its Japan-market transcripts through Bloomberg Terminal. Its current library page describes Japan as its deepest coverage, with expansion into Korea and Taiwan.

In its January 8, 2026 company history, Arches reported $6 million raised and reiterated a goal of an IPO by 2028. This is a company-stated ambition, not a confirmed listing schedule.

history.narrative:
Arches was co-founded by Hiroki Kato (CEO) and Shota Kambara (COO). Arches says Kato studied economics at the University of Tokyo, worked at Sumitomo Corporation and YCP Solidiance, and was selected as a World Economic Forum Global Shaper. It says Kambara studied economics at Waseda University and worked at Accenture Strategy and Terradrone, including cross-border M&A.

Arches announced $1.6 million in funding in December 2021 from Uzabase, Hakuhodo DY Ventures, and angel investors. Its June 2024 release reported another 410 million yen, bringing funding to 640 million yen at that time. Its January 2026 retrospective reported $6 million raised; that later figure is company-stated.

servicesDetailed.name: Expert Calls
servicesDetailed.description: Arches offers one-on-one calls with project-specific expert recruitment across APAC, North America, EMEA, and LATAM. It advertises 30–60 minute formats, a free 10-minute screening call, and recordings with AI transcripts.

servicesDetailed.name: Expert Transcript Library
servicesDetailed.description: Arches describes a subscription library searchable by company or sector, with AI summaries and transcript export. Its current page reports 1,500+ expert interview transcripts, around 100 additions monthly, and earnings calls from 250+ Japanese companies. These are company-stated figures.

servicesDetailed.name: Custom Research and Consulting
servicesDetailed.description: Research projects combine market exploration, fieldwork, and expert research. Arches says engagement scope can extend to regional expansion and that fees depend on the question rather than a fixed consulting package.

servicesDetailed.name: Prime Talent Partners
servicesDetailed.description: Executive search and recruitment for funds, consulting firms, investment banks, and leadership roles at portfolio companies.

servicesDetailed.name: Expert Surveys & On-site Consultations
servicesDetailed.description: Arches’ terms describe questionnaires, site visits, group discussions, seminars, and in-person interviews among supported engagement formats.

aiPlatform.narrative: Arches now advertises AI summaries within its Expert Transcript Library and AI transcripts for expert calls. Its December 2025 Bloomberg announcement describes ETL access via Document Search {DS <GO>} and Bloomberg’s AI-enhanced Document Search & Analysis. The sources reviewed do not establish AI-powered expert matching.
features: AI summaries in the Expert Transcript Library

complianceExtended.narrative: Arches’ published expert terms prohibit disclosure of confidential information and MNPI. They require conflict disclosures and prohibit assignments involving direct competitors of an expert’s current employer. The terms reserve rights to check identity and professional or educational background. These are published contractual provisions; their operational effectiveness was not independently assessed.
highlights: Terms prohibit confidential information and MNPI disclosure
Experts must disclose relevant financial interests and conflicts
Identity and background checks may use internal or third-party resources
Expert recording or transcription requires company consent

clientFit.narrative: Editorial assessment based on the published services: Arches may suit investors and consulting teams seeking Asia-Pacific research, especially Japanese-market interviews and transcripts.
segments: PE firms and hedge funds researching Asian markets
Strategy consulting firms seeking expert interviews
